AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.

7. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

8. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.

9. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

10. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

11. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.

12. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities in Aviation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
